# templates

```go
import "github.com/shdeen/bildomat/internal/templates"
```

Package templates holds the copy catalog source \(copy.toml, generated into per\-package constants by tools/copygen\) and the embedded page\-scale copy in the .tmpl files, so every wording is edited without touching rendering code.

## Index

- [Variables](<#variables>)

```go

```

<a name="CompactUsageText"></a>CompactUsageText is the compact usage template rendered for invalid command\-line input.

```go
var CompactUsageText string
```

<a name="ExamplesText"></a>ExamplesText defines the model and search examples shared by help and provider summaries.

```go
var ExamplesText string
```

<a name="HelpCommandText"></a>HelpCommandText is one command's help page: its usage form and its flags.

```go
var HelpCommandText string
```

<a name="HelpMainText"></a>HelpMainText is the general help page: the usage forms, the commands, the flags, and the tips.

```go
var HelpMainText string
```

<a name="HelpTipsText"></a>HelpTipsText is the tips section of the general help page: the fully qualified model form and the info and search examples.

```go
var HelpTipsText string
```

<a name="ListModelsText"></a>ListModelsText is the flat model directory: one fully qualified key per line.

```go
var ListModelsText string
```

<a name="ListNestedText"></a>ListNestedText is the default listing: each provider with its models by medium.

```go
var ListNestedText string
```

<a name="ListProvidersText"></a>ListProvidersText is the providers listing: one line per provider.

```go
var ListProvidersText string
```

<a name="ModelInfoText"></a>ModelInfoText is the model card: the model's identity block and one option per declared parameter.

```go
var ModelInfoText string
```

<a name="ProviderHeaderText"></a>ProviderHeaderText defines the identity and catalog totals shared by provider pages.

```go
var ProviderHeaderText string
```

<a name="ProviderInfoText"></a>ProviderInfoText is the standard provider page: the provider's identity and catalog counts, then per medium its model roster and options.

```go
var ProviderInfoText string
```

<a name="ProviderSummaryText"></a>ProviderSummaryText is the aggregator summary: the provider's identity and catalog counts, its vendors and shared flags per medium, and the next commands.
